regnal.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the reign of a monarch; as, regnal
   years.
regnal.translation: a. 帝王的, 王国的

regnancy.definition:
n. The condition or quality of being regnant; sovereignty;
   rule.

regnant.translation:
a. 统治的, 占优势的
[法] 统治的, 占优势的, 流行的; 复准, 回让财产给原主

regnoli's operation.translation: [医] 雷格诺利氏手术(舌切除的一种方法)

regnum.translation: n. 统治, 统治期间
